info.title: SoroVault
info.summary: A contract interface (ABI) registry for Stellar/Soroban.
info.description: SoroVault decodes deployed contract WASM and serves protocol-provided Stellar Asset Contract interfaces under a stable built-in identifier. The ABI JSON is the project's public contract; `abi_version` is bumped if it ever changes incompatibly.

get.description: Does not touch the database or RPC.
Checks Postgres and the configured RPC network. Answers are cached for a few seconds. Unlike /healthz, a failure means this instance cannot serve and should be taken out of rotation.

200.description: The database answers and the RPC endpoint serves the configured network.

503.description: At least one dependency is failing; `checks` names each one and carries its error.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the contract ID, its name, or a function, type or event name in its current interface.

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: Only contracts whose current interface declares a function with exactly this name. Repeatable; every name must match. Case-sensitive.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only contracts whose current interface declares a user-defined type with exactly this name. Repeatable; every name must match. Case-sensitive.

parameters.name: implements
parameters.description: Only contracts implementing every listed standard interface ID, such as sep41. Repeatable.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Deprecated. Rows to skip; keep paging with cursor instead — offsets repeat and skip rows added while a client pages.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next cursor of the previous page. Opaque; pass it back unchanged. A cursor and an offset are exclusive. Unreadable cursors are a 400.

post.description: Fetches the contract's WASM, decodes its interface and stores it. Idempotent: registering a known contract re-verifies it, and records a new interface version if it was upgraded.

post.summary: Register several contracts in one request
post.description: Registers up to 20 contracts, one after another, and reports one result per contract. The contracts are processed sequentially, so the batch draws on the registry's concurrency budget once per contract rather than all at once, and one failure does not stop the rest: every contract gets a result of its own, with the status code it would have had on its own request.

200.description: Every contract was processed; each result says what became of it.

post.summary: Register a webhook URL for a set of contracts
post.description: Registers a webhook URL that will be notified when any of the specified contracts' interfaces change. Returns a secret used to sign deliveries.

delete.description: Removes a webhook subscription by its secret.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: The secret returned when the subscription was created.

post.summary: Decode an uploaded WASM module without storing it
post.description: Decodes the contractspecv0 section of the uploaded module and returns its interface. Nothing is stored and neither the network nor the database is touched. The body is the raw module, whatever its content type, or a multipart/form-data upload whose first file part carries it. Shares the per-client rate limit with registration and refresh.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json (the default) returns the interface; ts returns the generated TypeScript client.

200.description: The decoded interface, or the TypeScript client when format=ts.

413.description: The upload exceeds the size limit, which the error states.

422.description: The body is not a WebAssembly module, or its spec section does not decode.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: A non-empty value sets Content-Disposition: attachment, so the interface is saved as <contract>.<short-hash>.abi.json.

get.summary: Get a catalogued uploaded WASM interface

post.summary: Catalog uploaded code by WASM hash
post.description: Fetches and decodes uploaded code even when no deployed contract currently references it.

get.summary: List every contract running a given WASM
get.description: Many contracts share one WASM: every instance of a token template, every vault a factory deployed. This answers who else runs a given piece of code, which is the question a vulnerability in a shared WASM raises. With `ever=true` the listing also covers the contracts that ran the hash in the past and have since been upgraded; each result says whether the contract still runs it.

parameters.name: ever
parameters.description: Also list the contracts that ran the hash in the past, not only the ones running it now.

get.summary: A JSON Schema for a function's arguments
get.description: A JSON Schema (2020-12) describing the function's arguments object, derived from the contract's stored interface. A wallet or a dApp can render a form from it and validate the user's input before encoding it. Integers wider than 53 bits are decimal strings, addresses and byte strings carry patterns, options are nullable, and user-defined types become $defs.

get.summary: An example argument list for a function
get.description: One example argument object for the function: a deterministic placeholder value of each argument's type, keyed as the function's JSON Schema spells them. A client takes it, replaces the fields it cares about, and has its first request. Derived from the same stored interface the schema is, so the example validates where the schema accepts.
Returns function names and signatures without documentation or other interface details.

The events a contract declares, each with its topics, data fields and the data payload's packing, for the indexers that react to them without reading the whole interface. A contract that declares none answers with an empty list.

get.summary: Every stored interface version, newest first

post.summary: Re-check a registered contract against the network

200.description: Refreshed. `changed` is true when a new interface version was recorded.

get.description: Generated from the stored interface; builds on @stellar/stellar-sdk >= 14. The file embeds the WASM hash it was generated for as the wasmHash export and exposes assertSameWasm(liveHash) to warn on a mismatch; the check is opt-in.

parameters.name: zod
parameters.description: A non-empty value appends Zod schemas for the declared types and function arguments, for runtime validation.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: A non-empty value sets Content-Disposition: attachment.

get.description: Contract and interface-version counts per network, the most recently registered contract, and the most recent automatic refresh sweep. `last_refresh` is omitted when automatic refresh is not enabled.

200.description: The registry's size at a glance.

get.description: One event per stored interface version that replaced an earlier one, newest first. A contract's first registration is not an upgrade, so it is excluded.

get.summary: Recent interface upgrades as an Atom feed
get.description: The same events as /api/upgrades, in Atom 1.0 (RFC 4287), so feed readers can subscribe directly. A page with more events carries a rel="next" link.

200.description: An Atom 1.0 feed of recent upgrades.

network.name: network
network.description: Network namespace, e.g. testnet or public. Defaults to the network this instance's RPC serves.

wasmHash.name: wasm_hash
wasmHash.description: Select a superseded interface version by WASM hash instead of the current one.

BadRequest.description: Malformed input, such as an invalid contract ID.

NotFound.description: No such contract, version or function.

NoInterface.description: The contract exists but has no interface to serve: a Stellar asset contract, or a module without a contractspecv0 section.

TooManyRequests.description: The client has exceeded the configured rate limit for registrations and refreshes. The response carries a Retry-After header saying how long to wait before trying again.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The request could not be served now. Either the RPC endpoint serves a different network than NETWORK_PASSPHRASE, or the registry is already registering as many contracts as it is allowed to. In the second case the response carries a Retry-After header saying how long to wait before trying again.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present when the registry was busy.

results.error: stellar: contract not found on network: CDZZZPYQALFRBQAZD5KCW2SZK4ZF455PJVD7H53AGHXTWAJO4BYVPP2V

id.description: Always empty in listings: the ID is the subscription's secret.

Readiness.description: A readiness answer. `checks` contains one entry per dependency: database and rpc.

versions.description: Stored interface versions, including superseded ones.

networks.description: Every network with a registered contract, ordered by name.

versions.description: Stored interface versions across every network.

latest_contract.description: The most recently registered contract. Absent when the registry is empty.

last_refresh.description: The most recent automatic refresh sweep. Absent when refresh is disabled or no sweep has finished yet.

changed.description: Contracts that had been upgraded since the previous check.

failed.description: Contracts that could not be refreshed.

busy.description: Contracts deferred because the registry was at its concurrency limit.

missing.description: Contracts no longer on the network.

observed_at.description: When the new interface version was recorded.

WasmHash.description: SHA-256 of the contract's WASM module, hex.

current_wasm_hash.description: WASM SHA-256 for uploaded contracts, or a stable built-in interface identifier for protocol contracts such as SACs.

missing_since.description: When a refresh last found the contract absent from the network. Absent while the contract is live.

matches.description: Interface symbols a search query matched. Only present on search results.

implements.description: Standard interface IDs detected from the current contract interface.

next.description: The cursor of the following page, absent once the listing has ended.

changed.description: A new interface version was recorded.

previous_wasm_hash.description: The hash the contract ran before the change. Absent when nothing changed.

missing.description: The contract could not be found on the network. Its record is kept and marked as missing rather than the call failing.

created.description: How many contracts were new to the registry.

unchanged.description: How many were already registered and unchanged.

changed.description: How many were already registered but have been upgraded.

failed.description: How many could not be registered.

contract_id.description: The contract this result is about. It is echoed as sent, since a bad address has no canonical form.

status.description: created: new to the registry. unchanged: already registered and the same. changed: already registered but upgraded. error: it could not be registered.

error.description: Why the contract could not be registered.

code.description: The status code the contract would have had on its own request.

WasmContractList.description: The contracts that run a given WASM hash.

ever.description: True when the listing also covers the contracts that ran the hash in the past.

current.description: True when the contract runs the hash now, false when it only ran it in the past.

wasm_hash.description: Omitted for built-in interfaces that have no uploaded WASM.

interface_id.description: Stable identifier for a built-in interface without WASM.

builtin.description: True when supplied by the Stellar protocol rather than decoded from uploaded WASM.

missing_since.description: When a refresh last found the contract absent from the network. Absent while the contract is live.

current.description: False when an older version was requested with wasm_hash.

implements.description: Standard interface IDs detected from the current contract interface.

FunctionExample.description: An example argument object. Keys are the function's argument names, each value a deterministic placeholder of that argument's type that satisfies the argument as the function's JSON Schema spells it: integers wider than 53 bits are decimal strings, addresses and byte strings are strings, options are null, and empty collections are empty.

Interface.description: A contract's decoded interface. Empty collections are [], never null.

builtin.description: True when supplied by the Stellar protocol, not decoded from uploaded WASM.

source.description: Normative source for a built-in interface.

meta.description: Build metadata from contractmetav0 (rsver, rssdkver). Omitted when absent.

EnvMeta.description: The host environment the contract was built against, from contractenvmetav0. Omitted when the contract carries no such section.

interface_version.description: The host interface version the contract targets, written the way a version number is.

protocol.description: The protocol version the contract was built against, and the lowest protocol it will run on.

pre_release.description: The pre-release number of the protocol version. Zero for a released protocol, and omitted then.

outputs.description: Empty means the function returns nothing.

Type.description: A value type. Scalars carry only kind and display; containers add the fields their kind needs.

is_tuple.description: A Rust tuple struct; fields are named "0", "1", ...
